blocks.text: PORTAL Folding Rocking Chair Portable Oversized High Mesh Back Patio Lounge Camp Rocker, Support 300lbs

items.label: Oversized Rocking Chair
items.value: The outdoor rocking chair is oversizely designed with wider seat and can support up to 400lbs. Everyone can enjoy a brisk rocking by sitting in it comfortablely by yourself or with your kids!

items.label: 29" High Padded Back
items.value: This camping rocking chair has a 29" padded backrest which will provide full support to your shoulders and head. The padded back is specially designed to provide enough coziness for you to relax and chill. It also has pockets and a cup holder on the sides for your convenience.

items.label: Heavy Duty with Hard Armrests
items.value: This camping rocking chair is sturdy and easy in and out. Constructed with a sturdy thickened steel frame and high density polyester, you can absolutely trust its sturdiess to embrace nature and life to the fullest!

items.label: Easy to Fold and Unfold
items.value: There is almost no assembly needed, and it only takes 10s to complete! Once you know the trick, you'll be amazed at how easy the folded design is! Please refer to the step-by-step diagram and video, or contact us to learn more.

items.label: Portable and Compact
items.value: The unique folding design allows it to be folded into a bundle and placed in the carrying bag within a few seconds, making it a much smaller folded size than other regular rockers. You can easily bring it to camp, concerts, games, outdoor sports, or just use it in the backyard, etc.

items.label: Reminder
items.value: The user manual is sewed under the seat. Make sure you read it before assembly.

items.label: Included Components
items.value: Carry bag, Rocking chair, Side pocket

Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Easy to assemble with minimal instructions
